changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO leave_type (name, label, max_days_per_year, carry_over_days, paid, requires_medical, active, company_id) SELECT 'ABSENCE_NON_JUSTIFIEE', 'Absence non justifiée', 365, 0, false, false, true, c.id FROM company c WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM leave_type lt WHERE lt.company_id = c.id AND lt.name = 'ABSENCE_NON_JUSTIFIEE' );
